Scholarship overview

Auckland considers eligible doctoral admission applicants for its university scholarships. Candidates indicate that they want scholarship consideration in the admission process and should avoid enrolling before receiving the scholarship outcome, as specified in the university guidance.

Research Areas

  • Eligible Auckland doctoral subjects
  • Doctoral research
  • Research training

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 35,468/year (2026 rate), plus tuition

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsAutomatic consideration through doctoral admission; later quarterly rounds available.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round1 November 2026 next round
LocationNew Zealand

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About University of Auckland

Auckland offers doctoral research through its faculties and research centres. Eligible admission applicants are considered for university doctoral scholarships through scheduled funding rounds rather than a separate general scholarship application.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions
